title: Mass. medical delivery worker charged after allegedly assaulting woman in wheelchair
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Qaisar Ali, 39, from Brockton, was arrested on August 5 by East Bridgewater Police for allegedly assaulting a woman in a wheelchair.
Ali faces charges including assault and battery and indecent assault on an elderly or disabled person, and breaking and entering.
Ali was held on a $10,000 bail and was arraigned in Brockton District Court after his arrest by police.

title: Livestream: Lindsay Clancy murder trial closes out second week after friends and former father-in-law testify
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Lindsay Clancy's trial concludes its second week, with testimony from friends and her former father-in-law describing her as a loving mother.
Clancy's defense argues insanity, citing postpartum mental illness, while prosecutors claim deliberate action due to discontent with motherhood.
Testimonies from friends and daycare staff highlight Clancy's mental health struggles but describe her as caring and involved with her children.

title: 5 takeaways as Red Sox overcome 5 deficits to outlast White Sox in 13 innings for 8th straight victory
author: Trevor Hass
bullets: Boston Red Sox win 12-11 against Chicago White Sox in 13 innings, achieving their 8th straight victory.
Caleb Durbin's walk-off RBI single highlights the game; he contributes 3-for-6 performance with six winning RBIs.
The game featured five comebacks by the Red Sox and required 17 pitchers, consuming nearly five hours.

title: Patriots Stock Watch 1.0: Who is rising, falling on depth chart after 11 days of practice?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez are rising stars in Patriots training camp, showcasing standout performances and strong chemistry.
Chad Muma emerges as a leader for the third linebacker spot, gaining reps with New England's projected starters.
Caleb Lomu, a 2026 first-round pick, struggles in camp, falling behind Marcus Bryant on the depth chart.

title: Could Franklin Arias join Red Sox before end of 2026 season?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Franklin Arias is a top prospect batting .326 with 12 RBIs in 10 Triple-A games for Worcester.
Red Sox face decisions on roster with injuries to Trevor Story and Isiah Kiner-Falefa at shortstop.
Red Sox officials are undecided on a 2026 MLB call-up for 20-year-old Arias despite his strong performances.

title: Police search for person they say broke into Jamaica Plain apartment, tried to pull blanket off sleeping victim
author: Audrey Cooney
bullets: Boston police seek help identifying a suspect who broke into a Jamaica Plain apartment on the morning of August 5.
The suspect allegedly entered through a window and attempted to remove a blanket from the sleeping victim.
The suspect is described as a Black male in his late teens or early 20s, with slim build and short hair.

title: Why did this part break so quickly on my 2023 pickup?
author: John Paul
bullets: John Paul discusses a 2023 Ford Maverick's front sway bar links failing at 22,000 miles due to part quality.
Torx-Plus fasteners are highlighted for their strength and precision, used for automated assembly to reduce stripping.
CTEK and Deltran's Battery Tender chargers are recommended for maintaining battery life for infrequently used vehicles.

title: 5 takeaways from Jaylen Brown’s introductory press conference with 76ers
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Jaylen Brown expressed mixed emotions about his trade from Boston Celtics to Philadelphia 76ers at his first press conference.
Brown acknowledged a lack of personal relationship with former Celtics teammate Jayson Tatum post-trade.
He expressed gratitude for his decade-long tenure in Boston while also embracing new opportunities in Philadelphia.

title: 4 injured in Boston school bus rollover, police say
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Four adults injured in a school bus rollover on Harvard St. in Mattapan, Boston, Thursday afternoon.
Injuries from the bus crash are non-life-threatening; all victims transported to a nearby hospital.
The cause of the school bus rollover is unclear, and no children were involved, say police.

title: Drake Maye struggled during two-minute drill, and other takeaways from Day 11 of Patriots training camp
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Drake Maye threw two interceptions in the Patriots' two-minute drill, with standout plays by Marcus Jones and Kevin Byard.
In Will Campbell's absence, Marcus Bryant took first-team reps at left tackle, while rookie Caleb Lomu remained with the second team.
Returner pairings for the Patriots include Lan Larrison with Efton Chism, and Kyle Williams with Terrell Jennings, as they finalize their roster.
